definitions.text_mt: Biċċa drapp jew materjal ieħor użat bħala parti minn libsa jew ħjata.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-ħajjiet qatgħet ġurun drapp għall-libsa l-ġdida.
usage_examples.text_en: The seamstress cut a panel of fabric for the new dress.

usage_examples.text_mt: Dawn il-ġurun tal-ħarir huma delikati ħafna.
usage_examples.text_en: These silk panels are very delicate.

definitions.text_mt: Li hu skont il-ġustizzja u l-liġi.
Li hu ġust u onest.

usage_examples.text_mt: L-imħallef kien ġust fid-deċiżjoni tiegħu.
usage_examples.text_en: The judge was just in his decision.

usage_examples.text_mt: Mhux ġust li tittratta lin-nies b'mod differenti.
usage_examples.text_en: It is not fair to treat people differently.

definitions.text_en: Justice (principle or degree of being just)
definitions.text_mt: Il-prinċipju li kulħadd jingħata dak li jistħoqqlu skont il-liġi.
Is-sistema ta' liġijiet u istituzzjonijiet li jamministraw il-liġi.
Il-fergħa tal-gvern li tinterpreta u tamministra l-liġi.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-ġustizzja hi l-pedament ta' soċjetà ċivilizzata.
usage_examples.text_en: Justice is the foundation of a civilised society.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-qorti twettaq il-ġustizzja b'mod indipendenti.
usage_examples.text_en: The court administers justice independently.

usage_examples.text_mt: Is-sistema tal-ġustizzja trid tkun aċċessibbli għal kulħadd.
usage_examples.text_en: The justice system must be accessible to everyone.

etymology_chain.definition: A youth, a young man, young woman, young adult ( between ages 20-40 ), ( older than an adulescens but younger than a senior / senex )

definitions.text_mt: Raġel żgħir fl-età, adult żagħżugħ.
Tifel jew adolexxent ta' sess maskili.
Tifel żgħir, speċjalment wieħed ferrieħi.

usage_examples.text_mt: Dak il-ġuvni għadu żgħir wisq biex imur il-każin.
usage_examples.text_en: That young man is still too young to go to the club.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-ġuvintur tal-lum għandhom ħafna opportunitajiet.
usage_examples.text_en: Today's youths have many opportunities.

usage_examples.text_mt: Kien ġuvni sabiħ u edukat li kien jogħġob lil kulħadd.
usage_examples.text_en: He was a handsome, well-mannered lad who pleased everyone.

definitions.text_mt: Tifel jew żagħżugħ żgħir.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-ġuvnott lagħab fit-triq ma' sħabu.
usage_examples.text_en: The lad played in the street with his friends.

usage_examples.text_mt: Ara kif jikber dan il-ġuvnott!
usage_examples.text_en: Look how this boy is growing up!

definitions.text_mt: Ortografija alternattiva ta' 'ġuġù': ħelu żgħir magħmul taz-zokkor.

usage_examples.text_mt: Ixtri ftit ġuġun mit-tabakka.
usage_examples.text_en: Buy some sweets from the tobacconist.

definitions.text_mt: Ħelu żgħir magħmul taz-zokkor, ħafna drabi b'togħmiet differenti tal-frott.

usage_examples.text_mt: It-tfal iħobbu l-ġuġù.
usage_examples.text_en: Children love sweets.

usage_examples.text_mt: Ġuġù jinstab fil-ħwienet tal-ħelu u t-tabakk.
usage_examples.text_en: Sweets are found in confectionery shops and tobacconists.

definitions.text_mt: Xewqa qawwija li tiekol minħabba li l-istonku jkun vojt.
Nuqqas ta' mezzi materjali, faqar estrem.

usage_examples.text_mt: Wara l-vjaġġ kollu, ħassejt ġuħ qawwi.
usage_examples.text_en: After the whole journey, I felt intense hunger.

usage_examples.text_mt: Ħafna nies ibatu l-ġuħ f'pajjiżi li għadhom qed jiżviluppaw.
usage_examples.text_en: Many people suffer from hunger in developing countries.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-ġuħ hu problema serja f'ħafna partijiet tad-dinja.
usage_examples.text_en: Hunger is a serious problem in many parts of the world.

definitions.text_mt: Isem propju maskili, ekwivalenti għall-Ingliż John.

usage_examples.text_en: John is a very common name in Malta.

usage_examples.text_mt: Is-Sur Ġwann Borg għandu ħanut fil-belt.
usage_examples.text_en: Mr John Borg has a shop in Valletta.

definitions.text_mt: Ortografija alternattiva ta' 'Ġwann': isem propju maskili.

usage_examples.text_mt: Ġwanni ġie mistieden għall-festa tar-raħal.
usage_examples.text_en: John was invited to the village feast.

definitions.text_mt: Li juri umiltà, li ma jiftaħarx b'ħilietu jew b'ġidu.

usage_examples.text_mt: Huwa raġel ġwejdi u kwiet.
usage_examples.text_en: He is a modest and quiet man.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-ħwejjeġ tagħha kienu ġwejdin u sempliċi.
usage_examples.text_en: Her clothes were modest and simple.

definitions.text_mt: Nuqqas ta' kuraġġ, biża' eċċessiv quddiem il-periklu jew l-isfidi.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-ġwejferija mhix kwalità ammirevoli f'suldat.
usage_examples.text_en: Cowardice is not an admirable quality in a soldier.

usage_examples.text_mt: Ġwejferija hi li taħrab mill-problemi minflok tiffaċċjahom.
usage_examples.text_en: Cowardice is running away from problems instead of facing them.

definitions.text_mt: Li ma jitkellimx ħafna, li huwa kwiet u kalm fin-natura tiegħu.

usage_examples.text_mt: Huwa tifel ġwejjed u edukat.
usage_examples.text_en: He is a quiet and well-mannered boy.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-viċin tagħna huwa raġel ġwejjed li dejjem iżomm għalih.
usage_examples.text_en: Our neighbour is a quiet man who always keeps to himself.

definitions.text_mt: Li faċilment jibża' jew jintimidaw, li m'għandux kunfidenza fih innifsu.

usage_examples.text_mt: It-tifel kien ġwejjef u ma kellux ħbieb.
usage_examples.text_en: The boy was timid and had no friends.

usage_examples.text_mt: L-annimal kien ġwejjef u ħarab minn quddiemna.
usage_examples.text_en: The animal was timid and ran away from us.

definitions.text_mt: Plural ta' 'ġifa': fjuri.

usage_examples.text_mt: Dawn il-ġwejjef huma sbieħ ħafna.
usage_examples.text_en: These flowers are very beautiful.

definitions.text_mt: Dinimuttiv ta' 'ġewnaħ': ġewnaħ żgħir.

usage_examples.text_mt: L-għasfur kellu ġwejnaħ miksur.
usage_examples.text_en: The bird had a small broken wing.

definitions.text_mt: Dinimuttiv ta' 'ġewżaq': ġewżaq żgħir.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-qattus kien ġwejżaq ċkejken u ferrieħi.
usage_examples.text_en: The kitten was tiny and playful.

definitions.text_mt: Għalf għall-annimali, bħal tiben jew ħaxix niexef.
Plural ta' 'ġewż': frotta ta' siġra tal-ġewż.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-bidwi ħa l-ġwież biex jitma' l-bhejjem.
usage_examples.text_en: The farmer took the fodder to feed the livestock.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-ġwież huwa importanti għan-nutrizzjoni tal-annimali.
usage_examples.text_en: Fodder is important for animal nutrition.

definitions.text_mt: Qarraq b'xi ħadd billi tah informazzjoni falza.

usage_examples.text_mt: Huwa ġġakbina lill-ħbieb tiegħu biex jieħu l-flus.
usage_examples.text_en: He deceived his friends to take the money.

usage_examples.text_mt: Tippruvax tgħaġġakbina bil-qerq tiegħek.
usage_examples.text_en: Do not try to deceive us with your trickery.

definitions.text_mt: Rifes vettura billi uża ġakk biex ibiddel tajer.

usage_examples.text_mt: Ġġakkja l-karozza biex ibiddel it-tajer.
usage_examples.text_en: He jacked up the car to change the tyre.

usage_examples.text_mt: Jeħtieġ li tgħaġġakkja l-vettura qabel tibda tiswija.
usage_examples.text_en: You need to jack up the vehicle before starting repairs.

definitions.text_en: To jam (to get something stuck in a confined space)
definitions.text_mt: Waħħal xi ħaġa f'post dejjaq b'mod li ma tistax tiċċaqlaq.

definitions.text_en: To jam (to block or confuse a broadcast signal)
definitions.text_mt: Fixkel sinjal tar-radju jew tat-televiżjoni billi trażmetti sinjal ieħor.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-karta ġġammjat fil-printer u waqfet taħdem.
usage_examples.text_en: The paper jammed in the printer and stopped working.

usage_examples.text_mt: Huma ġġammjaw is-sinjal tar-radju matul il-kriżi.
usage_examples.text_en: They jammed the radio signal during the crisis.

definitions.text_mt: Il-forma mediopassiva ta' 'ġebbed': infirex jew twal.
Iddiskuta l-prezz ma' bejjiegħ biex jikseb prezz orħos.

definitions.text_en: Inflection of ġebbed: second-person singular imperfect third-person feminine singular imperfect
definitions.text_mt: Inflessjoni ta' 'ġebbed': it-tieni persuna singular imperfett jew it-tielet persuna femminili singular imperfett.

usage_examples.text_mt: Iż-żewġ naħat bdew jitgħaġġebdu fuq il-prezz tal-art.
usage_examples.text_en: The two sides began haggling over the price of the land.

usage_examples.text_mt: Is-suq Malti huwa post fejn in-nies jitgħaġġebdu.
usage_examples.text_en: The Maltese market is a place where people haggle.

definitions.text_mt: Il-forma mediopassiva ta' 'ġebbes': sar imqadded jew imfarrad.

definitions.text_en: Inflection of ġebbes: second-person singular imperfect third-person feminine singular imperfect

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-ġobon ġġebbes fix-xemx.
usage_examples.text_en: The cheese dried up in the sun.

etymology_chain.definition: to freeze, to chill, to frost

definitions.text_mt: Għatta b'saff ta' ġelat jew kisi ħelu fuq kejk jew deżerta.
Bidlu f'solidu b'sħana baxxa, sar silġ.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-kok ġġela l-kejk bil-krema.
usage_examples.text_en: The chef iced the cake with cream.

usage_examples.text_mt: L-ilma ġġela fil-friża matul il-lejl.
usage_examples.text_en: The water froze in the freezer overnight.

definitions.text_mt: Irripeta ħoss biex tagħmel konsonanti doppja fil-pronunzja.

usage_examples.text_mt: Fil-Malti, xi konsonanti jiġġeminaw f'ċerti pożizzjonijiet.
usage_examples.text_en: In Maltese, some consonants geminate in certain positions.
